rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 325 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (policy_regulation led 11-19, elections_public_opinion led 11-20, so geopolitics leads today, then policy_regulation, then elections_public_opinion); within each group the list starts at offset 325 % group_size in pool order (geopolitics 325 % 10 = 5: national AI strategy first; policy 325 % 15 = 10: state AI law first; elections 325 % 9 = 1: AI generated political ad first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds and agency press pages over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-20, so items published 11-20 (after the prior harvest) through 11-21 are in scope. Context: Saturday 11-21 in Korea / Friday 11-20 in the US and EU at harvest time — expect US agency Friday releases, court orders, Federal Register items dated 11-20, EU Friday items, and few Korean weekend releases (Korean items dated 11-20 afternoon / 11-21 are fine). Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: CCW 7th Review Conference Geneva closed 11-20 (now the adopted final document / decision on the LAWS GGE mandate or formal national statements posted by UNODA ARE new — high-priority check); Meta AI-scraping terms took effect 11-20 (only a new regulator/court order in a jurisdiction other than Brazil, or Meta formally changing/pausing the terms, is new); 중기부 모두의 창업 AI vendor security audit was due 11-20 (only published results/sanctions are new); House Foreign Affairs hearing with ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang (Mast's 879,000-license disclosure covered 11-20; only the hearing's formal outcome — subpoena, referral, bill markup, or BIS/Commerce license action — is new, not testimony coverage or reactions); SAFE AI Act (Jacobs/Maloy/Beyer outline covered 11-20; only formal introduction with a bill number is new); California next-steps AI safety recommendations (covered 11-20; only a bill text, an executive order, or Government Operations Agency rulemaking is new); Omnilert/BCPS Doritos AI gun-detection suit (covered 11-20; only a court order or a BCPS/county formal policy action is new); Dutch AP smart-glasses warning (covered 11-20; only formal enforcement, an EDPB statement, or another DPA's formal action is new); APEC Shenzhen ended 11-19 (only a signed joint statement / formal AI-incident channel text is new). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
